meta.title: Bea & Gábor — Wedding
meta.description: Bea & Gábor's wedding — 2026.08.22. • Ceremony 17:00 • Celebration 20:00 • Magic Harghita Resort

hero.subtitle: Wedding
hero.lead: Join us on this special day when we officially unite our lives!

rsvp.title: RSVP
rsvp.description: Help us with planning by sending a quick response! Please let us know your attendance intention and any dietary restrictions:
rsvp.deadline: Please respond via the form below or by phone by June 22.

location.title: Location
location.description: The wedding will be held at Magic Harghita Resort.
location.directions: How to find the venue: Coming from Odorheiu Secuiesc, turn left at Căpâlnița from the main road. From there, a 3 km road leads through the fields, straight to the Resort gate.
location.travelHelp: We are also happy to help organize travel: if there are enough participants, we will arrange a private bus. If you would like to take advantage of this option, please indicate your intention on the form below:

accommodation.title: Accommodation
accommodation.description: Accommodation can be booked at the venue for those who prefer the comfort of staying overnight rather than late-night driving or the possible bus option.
